name: mcp-openweather-arguments
description: mcp-go v0.29.0 changed CallToolRequest.Params.Arguments from map[string]any to any, so indexing it no longer compiles. Three reads in main.go break; the repository has no tests. A repair reads the arguments through request.GetArguments(), a checked (comma-ok) type assertion, or the request's GetString and RequireString helpers. An unchecked .(map[string]any) compiles and passes validation but panics on a call whose arguments are absent or not an object; the oracles fail it.
repair_evidence: the repository has no test files, so no test executes main.go
